label: Listening 1 — A new member at the sports club
lines: Listening one. A new member at the sports club. Listen and complete.
Hello! Welcome to the sports club. What's your name?
T. H. O. M. P. S. O. N.
Thanks. How old are you, Oliver?
OK. Can I have your phone number?
Sure. It's oh seven eight, three double six, nine one four.
My favourite colour is blue. My bag is blue, too!
Great. See you on Monday, then!

label: Listening 2 — A class photo
lines: Listening two. Two friends look at a class photo. True or false?
Daniel, is this your class photo?
Yes, it is. Look, this is our teacher, Mr Brown. He's from Scotland.
And who are these two girls?
They're my friends, Emma and Lucy. They aren't in my class now.
Who is the boy with the green bag?
That's Jack. His mum is a doctor and his dad is a pilot.
And where are you in the photo?
I'm here, next to the window. Look, I've got a red jumper.

label: Listening 3 — At the school shop
lines: Listening three. At the school shop. Circle the right answer.
Good morning! What would you like?
Hello. I would like three pencils, please. Blue ones.
Here you are, three blue pencils. Anything else?
Yes, please. Can I have an eraser, too?
Sorry, there are no erasers today. But we have got notebooks and rulers.
OK. Then I would like two notebooks, please.
Two notebooks. That's six pounds, please.
Six pounds. Here you are. Thank you!
